Posted by Winifred Garcia on February 3, 2019 at 11:37 am Sentiment for Lam Research Corp (NASDAQ:LRCX)
Lam Research Corp (NASDAQ:LRCX) institutional sentiment decreased to 0.77 in 2018 Q3 . Its down -0.28, from 1.05 in 2018Q2. The ratio turned negative, as 268 institutional investors started new or increased positions, while 347 sold and trimmed stock positions in Lam Research Corp. The institutional investors in our partner’s database now own: 133.35 million shares, down from 134.98 million shares in 2018Q2. Also, the number of institutional investors holding Lam Research Corp in their top 10 positions decreased from 7 to 6 for a decrease of 1. Sold All: 88 Reduced: 259 Increased: 191 New Position: 77.
Lam Research Corporation designs, manufactures, markets, refurbishes, and services semiconductor processing equipment used in the fabrication of integrated circuits worldwide. The company has market cap of $26.60 billion. The firm offers thin film deposition products, including SABRE electrochemical deposition products for copper damascene manufacturing; ALTUS systems to deposit conformal atomic layer films for tungsten metallization applications; VECTOR plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition and atomic layer deposition systems to deposit oxides, nitrides, and carbides for hardmasks, multiple patterning films, anti-reflective layers, multi-layer stack films, and diffusion barriers; and Striker atomic layer deposition systems that deliver conformal dielectric films for spacer patterning and liner applications in various advanced memory and logic structures. It has a 10.16 P/E ratio. The Company’s thin film deposition products also comprise SPEED high-density plasma CVD products for applications in shallow trench isolation, pre-metal dielectrics, inter-layer dielectrics, inter-metal dielectrics, and passivation layers; and SOLA ultraviolet thermal processing products for treatment of back-end-of-line (BEOL) low-k dielectric films and front-end-of-line silicon nitride strained films.
The stock increased 1.88% or $3.19 during the last trading session, reaching $172.77. About 2.89 million shares traded. Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) has declined 27.14% since February 3, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.14% the S&P500.
